stable_rules: Follow explicit task requirements in priority order.
Use the minimum planning depth needed to complete the task reliably.
Verify the deliverable against explicit acceptance criteria before returning it.
workflow: Parse the objective, deliverable, evidence boundary, constraints, and completion criteria.
Choose an execution path proportionate to complexity.
Produce the deliverable and run the quality gate.
default_stop_condition: Stop when the requested deliverable is complete and every quality check passes.
